comment: Hand-tuned renderer values on top of the lighting bible (Profiles/lighting-bible.json, generated from docs/proposals/look-fix-v1 by scripts/lookfix_data.py; its targets are never copied here). saturation: post-process saturation multiplier, tuned on the iPhone toward the bible's mean S. direct: multiplier on the weather model's direct sun toward the bible's key:fill and lift (§2.2-2.3). fill, groundFill: R8 fill multipliers toward the bible's lift and night floor. Measured with scripts/lighting_bible.py (6 Oct sweeps: clear days key 0.65 with fill 3.2 put the 15:30 shade-to-sun ratio at 0.37; night fill 0.6). weatherFullAt: the weather intensity (or cover) at which a label's bible state applies in full (the bible's light rain is 0.7 mm/h, intensity 0.22). Clear states interpolate by their fixtures' sun elevations; night blends moonless to moonlit by moon light below night.elevation; weather blends over the clear state by intensity in daylight.
